dogecoin.text: The only cryptocurrencies I advocate for henceforth will be Bitcoin & Dogecoin. They are the equivalent to digital gold & silver.

@CryptoBecks Although I agree with your sentiment - BTC, Etherium, Dogecoin, Solana, and many others are not resistant to quantum computing algorithms.
It only takes 9 hours to break into any arbitrary wallet, if provided the Public Key parameter rather than an address.
